One of those New York views that instantly feels iconic.

The New Yorker Hotel rising above Midtown Manhattan, surrounded by classic NYC rooftops, water towers, and endless city blocks. This is the kind of Manhattan skyline view I could photograph forever.

I edited these photos with my Dark Glow Lightroom preset to bring out the warm shadows, contrast, and cinematic New York tones.

Want the preset? Comment PRESET and I’ll send you the link.

This is how quickly the weather can change in New York.
